summary: Gate of supervision round 6: one question, whether to approve r209 and r210 (replacing r162, r163) as drafted.
questions: Are the supervision lines approved as drafted? Removed (retired): r162 (a question that names a term of the glossary or a glossary-proposal is left for the person) and r163 (each other question goes to a session under the delegation). Added: [r209] **When** a question of an initiative is a question of a glossary-proposal or has a reading that adds, changes or removes a `term/<term>`, `work run` shall leave the question for the person, giving it to no session under a delegation. (replaces r162). [r210] **Where** the request an initiative fulfils gives a delegation, `work run` shall give each question of the initiative that is neither a question of a glossary-proposal nor has a reading that adds, changes or removes a `term/<term>`, whatever words it uses, to a session of its own, given the delegation, the files that one question names and nothing else, which answers the question if the delegation covers it and leaves it for the person otherwise. (replaces r163). r176 is dropped, as you answered. Readings: (a) [recommended] approve r209 and r210 as drafted, retiring r162 and r163; (b) change their lines, saying how.
